changes.title: Circular map
items: The map is round now: about 196 areas in a circle round home, then a ring of quiet forest with nothing to do in it before the edge
Flying out to the edge slows you gently and drifts you back in, instead of a hard wall (?shape=square brings back the old square map)

changes.title: Boot music
items: The music waits for the first home speaker, then grows a layer with each one that comes alive, until the twelfth makes it whole

changes.title: Party witch roam
items: Party witches wander all round home, up to 40 m from the dancefloor, busiest near the middle
They drink, rest, chat and hold hands off the dancefloor, not on it
New: party witches swoop up over the treetops and back down, more often when you're up there yourself
However many soundsystems are playing, that many party witches come
Swoops go to all sorts of heights, from low hops to soaring well over the canopy
The party only moves while you're near enough to see it (or up over the treetops), which saves time
